title: Memory Shard
summary: Use the shard and pass a DC 10 Arcana check to initiate or advance the Adamantine Forge quest.

fields.Use: Single use. A successful DC 10 Arcana check starts the dialogue and cutscenes. Choosing to focus on the glow deals minor damage.
fields.Inspiration: Pass the checks for this shard, Scribbled Notes, and The Great Furnace of Grymforge to award If I Can’t Have It… Inspiration to Sage party members.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Dhourn, among the petrified drow west of the Selûnite Outpost, X 121, Y −245.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
